name: poke-flute
effect: Wakes up sleeping Pokémon. Required to wake up sleeping Snorlax on the overworld.
short_effect: Use to awaken sleeping Pokémon, including Snorlax on roads.

flavor_text.sun-moon: A flute that can play with such a beautiful tone that even sleeping Pokémon find themselves roused.
flavor_text.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: A flute that can play with such a beautiful tone that even sleeping Pokémon find themselves roused.
flavor_text.lets-go-pikachu-lets-go-eevee: A flute that can play with such a beautiful tone that even sleeping Pokémon find themselves woken up.
